resistant_source.why_resistant: The cogito negative control remains source-central while relation-genesis profiling correctly abstains; the local field still requires a testable representation that does not translate thinking/existence into relation ontology.

incompatible_unitizations.description: Treat recurrent source-native terms as a provisional local field before assigning a known ontological relation type.
incompatible_unitizations.analytic_consequence: The operator asks which distinctions appear from term co-presence without presupposing relation-first, relata-first, dependence or reciprocity.

incompatible_unitizations.description: Treat changes between adjacent argument windows as the primary analytic event rather than assuming one corpus-wide profile.
incompatible_unitizations.analytic_consequence: The operator preserves local regime shifts and can route different windows differently without turning variation into a universal ontology.

incompatible_unitizations.description: Treat recurrent absences and broken co-occurrences as provisional boundaries of the source's problem-space.
incompatible_unitizations.analytic_consequence: The operator can register what ceases to travel together without claiming that absence itself names a metaphysical structure.

observed_failure.description: The known operator vocabulary either abstains or routes the cogito through categories whose unitization is not source-born from the local thinking/existence field.
observed_failure.lost_distinction: The difference between a source-native cogito field and a generic absence of relation-genesis profile is lost.

mutation.proposal: Birth the source-signature family proposed by open-set discovery and keep it as an experimental rival to generic routing.
mutation.cost: One additional conditional family and a larger local search space; false novelty must be retired by regression.
mutation.reversibility: Delete the added family by its family_id; baseline registry bytes remain unchanged.

new_operator.title: Open-set source family: thinking / understanding / exist / mind
new_operator.diagnostic: What becomes visible in the local source field (thinking, understanding, exist, mind, thought) before it is translated into a pre-existing operator family?
new_operator.constructive_move: Compare term-field, window-transition and negative-boundary unitizations; preserve a null result when none adds a source-linked distinction.
new_operator.self_risk: Open-set discovery can become an exception factory that rewards novelty; retire the family if it does not add repeatable local discrimination beyond ordinary routing.
new_operator.positive_model: Micro-local source-signature probe with no presupposed ontology and explicit rollback to ordinary routing.

fixture.probe_text: Whenever this sentence I am, I exist, is spoken or thought of by me, it is necessarily true. It is my Thought; this alone cannot be separated from Me; I am, I exist. I am only a thinking thing, that is to say, a mind, or a soul, or understanding, or Reason.

before_after_test.before_observation: The same cogito span produces source resistance but no executable source-born conditional family.
before_after_test.after_observation: The same span activates a new reversible conditional family keyed to its own source-native terms while relation-genesis remains inactive.
before_after_test.discriminator: Retain the family only if it repeatedly distinguishes local cogito windows without activating relation-genesis or degrading source traceability.

negative_tests.name: relation-genesis remains a negative control
negative_tests.note: Known relation profile hints are empty in every micro-local window.
